_comment: Image-specific copy only — no layout/position/size here. Keyed by image id so a post's copy can only ever come from its own matching id; render.mjs fails if a layout entry's id has no matching copy entry, or vice versa. accentLineIndex is the 0-based headline line rendered in the locked accent color instead of the locked headline color.
